starlette/datastructures.py: Headers is an immutable, case-insensitive multidict: lookups ignore the case of the key, indexing returns the first value for a key and getlist every value in order, and headers built from a mapping store their keys lower-cased. On MutableHeaders, setting a key replaces its value, removes any duplicate entries and keeps the first entry's position; deleting a key removes every entry for it; setdefault sets the value only when the key is absent and returns the header's value either way; append adds an entry and keeps any duplicates; update sets each key of the mapping; `|` returns a new MutableHeaders and `|=` updates in place, and both reject a non-mapping with TypeError; add_vary_header appends to any existing Vary values, comma-separated. QueryParams and ImmutableMultiDict are immutable multidicts: indexing returns the last value for a key and getlist every value in order. MultiDict's setitem replaces every value for a key with the one given, append keeps existing ones, and poplist removes and returns them all. URLPath escapes backslashes as %5C, turns a leading '//' into '/%2F' so it is never read as an authority, and make_absolute_url uses https or wss when the base URL is secure and http or ws when it is not. Secret never shows its value in repr but returns it from str. State stores arbitrary attributes and raises AttributeError for one never set. URL's replace, include_query_params, replace_query_params and remove_query_params return a new URL and leave the original unchanged.
